observations.title: The spec literal rg --basename flag does not exist in ripgrep 15.2
observations.detail: rg --version 15.2.0: rg --basename -> unrecognized flag --basename (exit 2). The tool uses rg -l --no-ignore --hidden --fixed-strings plus the spec exclusions and a post-filter. This is a faithful equivalent; F8-control (raw sweep sees the census mention) and F8c (a live non-census reference still yields NOT-SAFE) prove the sweep is load-bearing, not vacuous.
observations.impact: none on the verdict; flagged because the binding spec text is not literally implementable.

observations.title: SAFE(pushed) can rest on local-branch evidence when a repo has zero refs/remotes/origin/*
observations.detail: D1 fallback step 3 resolves refs/heads/master. souji-shokunin itself has 0 remote-tracking refs (git -C souji-shokunin for-each-ref refs/remotes/ | wc -l -> 0), so K4 (census-summary.json) and K5 (LOG.md) returned SAFE(pushed) via default=refs/heads/master. Spec-compliant, but in such repos pushed is a local-only claim: no fetch is allowed, so remote state is unknowable.
observations.impact: calibration: removal gates in zero-remote repos inherit this weaker signal; round-1 fleet-root checks used origin/master directly.

observations.title: --stale-days 0 treats any past mtime as stale
observations.detail: A 1-hour-old .out file with --stale-days 0 -> SAFE(stale) (mtime_age_days=0 refs=0). Consistent with older-than-0-days, but callers should know 0 is not a no-op.

observations.title: Present, clean worktree on a fully pushed branch -> NOT-SAFE(worktree-live)
observations.detail: W4 (present + dirty) -> NOT-SAFE(dirty); a present clean registration has no removal receipt in the spec, and the tool returns NOT-SAFE(worktree-live). Conservative and correct under no-receipt-no-removal.

# S35 independent black-box probe battery for tools/souji-verify.sh (fixture phase).

set -euo pipefail

mkdir -p "$OUT" "$RAW" "$WS/tmp"

REAL_GIT=$(command -v git)
TOOL_SHA=$(sha256sum "$TOOL" | cut -d' ' -f1)
printf '%s' "$TOOL_SHA" > "$OUT/tool.sha256"
if [ ! -s "$WS/shim/git" ]; then sed "s|__REAL_GIT__|$REAL_GIT|" "$WS/shim-template.sh" > "$WS/shim/git"; fi
chmod +x "$WS/shim/git"
SHIMLOG="$OUT/shim-fixture.log"; : > "$SHIMLOG"
export SHIM_LOG="$SHIMLOG"

FIX=$(mktemp -d /tmp/souji-review-fixture.XXXXXX)
"$WS/setup-fixture.sh" "$FIX" >"$OUT/fixture-setup.out"
printf '%s' "$FIX" > "$OUT/fixture-path"

snapshot() { find "$FIX" -type f -not -path '*/.git/*' -printf '%P\t%s\t%T@\n' 2>/dev/null | sort; }
SNAP_BEFORE=$(mktemp -p "$WS/tmp"); SNAP_AFTER=$(mktemp -p "$WS/tmp")
snapshot > "$SNAP_BEFORE"

LAST_OUT=""; LAST_ERR=""; LAST_RC=0
probe() { # probe <id> <cwd> <shim 0|1> <args...>
  local id="$1" cwd="$2" shim="$3"; shift 3
  local so="$RAW/$id.stdout" se="$RAW/$id.stderr" rc=0
  local P="$PATH"
  [ "$shim" = 1 ] && P="$WS/shim:$PATH"
  set +e
  if [ "$SROOT" = "UNSET" ]; then
    ( cd "$cwd" && timeout 300 env -u SHOKUNIN_ROOT PATH="$P" TMPDIR="$WS/tmp" SHIM_LOG="$SHIMLOG" "$TOOL" "$@" ) >"$so" 2>"$se"
  else
    ( cd "$cwd" && timeout 300 env PATH="$P" TMPDIR="$WS/tmp" SHOKUNIN_ROOT="$SROOT" SHIM_LOG="$SHIMLOG" "$TOOL" "$@" ) >"$so" 2>"$se"
  fi
  rc=$?
  set -e
  LAST_OUT="$(cat "$so")"; LAST_ERR="$(cat "$se")"; LAST_RC=$rc
}
report() { # report <id> <expect> <verdict:pass|fail|info> <note?>
  local id="$1" expect="$2" verdict="$3" note="${4:-}" rawid out="" err=""
  rawid=${id,,}
  case "$id" in json) rawid=js;; esac
  [ -f "$RAW/$rawid.stdout" ] && out=$(cat "$RAW/$rawid.stdout")
  [ -f "$RAW/$rawid.stderr" ] && err=$(cat "$RAW/$rawid.stderr")
  jq -cn --arg id "$id" --arg expect "$expect" --arg verdict "$verdict" --arg note "$note" \
    --argjson rc "$LAST_RC" --arg out "$out" --arg err "$err" \
    '{id:$id,expect:$expect,verdict:$verdict,exit:$rc,stdout:$out,stderr:$err,note:$note}' >> "$RESULTS"
}
f1() { printf '%s\n' "$LAST_OUT" | sed -n '1p' | cut -f1; }
f3() { printf '%s\n' "$LAST_OUT" | sed -n '1p' | cut -f3; }
f4() { printf '%s\n' "$LAST_OUT" | sed -n '1p' | cut -f4; }
has() { case "$1" in *"$2"*) return 0;; *) return 1;; esac; }
nf() { printf '%s\n' "$LAST_OUT" | awk -F'\t' 'NF>0{n++} END{print n+0}'; }
all_nf_ok() { printf '%s\n' "$LAST_OUT" | awk -F'\t' 'NF>0 && NF!=5{bad=1} END{exit bad+0}'; }

    log|status|symbolic-ref|rev-parse|rev-list|merge-base|show|ls-files|ls-tree|for-each-ref|cat-file|describe|shortlog|blame|grep|show-ref|diff|diff-tree|name-rev|check-ignore) allow=1;;
    worktree)
      j=$((i+1)); sub=""
      while [ $j -lt $n ]; do b="${args[$j]}"; case "$b" in -*) : ;; *) sub="$b"; break;; esac; j=$((j+1)); done
      [ "$sub" = "list" ] && allow=1;;
    config)
      for b in "$@"; do case "$b" in --get|--get-all|--get-regexp|--list|-l|--show-origin) allow=1;; esac; done;;
  esac
  if [ "$allow" != 1 ]; then
    printf 'REFUSED cwd=%s verb=%s args=' "$PWD" "$verb" >> "$LOG"
    for a in "$@"; do printf ' %q' "$a" >> "$LOG"; done
    printf '\n' >> "$LOG"
    echo "souji-review-35 shim: refused non-read-only git on live tree: git $*" >&2
    exit 99
  fi
fi
exec "$REAL" "$@"
